notes.title: Chinese version now available! (by 起源汉化组)
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28350877/a31ec3dccfb4a9855daae923591ed7c5a04c9afc.jpg[/img]

We want to announce that the Chinese version of Saucer-Like is already available in the Steam store of the game.

Thank you so much to 起源汉化组 (Source Chinesizing Team) that has made this excellent work possible.

Hope the Chinese community enjoy!ːsteamhappyː

notes.title: Update: English and German texts
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

We have just update a new version of Saucer-Like fixing the English translation of the game correcting certain faults and errors. We also fixed some little programing problems with the German texts. Sorry about that!

Also we fixed a bug with the bowl object ;)

We still working hard in the game and in new updates. Sorry again for the inconveniences.

Regards
